description: This file implements the core logic for managing different virtual machine managers (VMMs) within the Cuttlefish project. It includes functions to select and configure VMMs like QEMU, Gem5, and Crosvm, as well as a command class for managing VMM-related commands. It also defines a dependency injection component for setting up VMM instances with the Fruit DI framework.

classes.name: VmmCommands
classes.description: A command source class that manages VMM commands, supporting late injection of dependencies and integration with the Cuttlefish configuration.

methods.name: GetVmManager
methods.description: Factory function that returns a unique pointer to a VmmManager instance based on the specified VmmMode and architecture.

methods.name: ConfigureMultipleBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot device properties for multiple disks, returning a map of boot device properties.

methods.name: VmmCommands::Commands
methods.description: Generates start commands for the VMM based on current configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: VmmCommands::LateInject
methods.description: Performs late dependency injection for VmmCommands, retrieving command dependencies.

methods.name: VmManagerComponent
methods.description: Creates a Fruit DI component that provides configured VmmManager instances and related command bindings.
